service.method:
SELECT T.HOUSE_CODE , T.COMPANY_CODE , T.SELLER_CODE , T.SELLER_NAME_LOC , T.IRS_NO FROM ( SELECT '999' HOUSE_CODE,'' COMPANY_CODE,'' SELLER_CODE,'' SELLER_NAME_LOC,'' IRS_NO FROM DUAL
UNION ALL /*일반*/ SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , SELLER_CODE , SELLER_NAME_LOC , SUBSTR(IRS_NO,1,3) || '-' || SUBSTR(IRS_NO,4,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(IRS_NO,6,5) AS IRS_NO FROM SSUGL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND ( UPPER(SELLER_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(SELLER_NAME_LOC) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(IRS_NO) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' AND 1=1 ) AND NVL(DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(PURCHASE_BLOCK_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND SELLER_COND IN ('P','R') AND ROWNUM <= 10
UNION ALL /*발주*/ SELECT SUGL.HOUSE_CODE , SUGL.COMPANY_CODE , SUGL.SELLER_CODE , SUGL.SELLER_NAME_LOC , SUGL.IRS_NO FROM SSUGL SUGL INNER JOIN SPOLN LN ON LN.HOUSE_CODE = SUGL.HOUSE_CODE WHERE SUGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SUGL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SUGL.SELLER_CODE = LN.SELLER_CODE AND LN.MATERIAL_NUMBER IN ($INS{MATERIAL_NUMBERS}) AND SUGL.PURCHASE_BLOCK_FLAG = 'N' AND SUGL.SELLER_COND IN ('P','R') AND ( UPPER(SUGL.SELLER_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(SUGL.SELLER_NAME_LOC) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(SUGL.IRS_NO) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' AND 1=1 ) GROUP BY SUGL.HOUSE_CODE , SUGL.COMPANY_CODE , SUGL.SELLER_CODE , SUGL.SELLER_NAME_LOC , SUGL.IRS_NO
UNION ALL /*견적*/ SELECT GL.HOUSE_CODE , GL.COMPANY_CODE , GL.SELLER_CODE , GL.SELLER_NAME_LOC , GL.IRS_NO
FROM SRQSE SE, SRQLN LN, SSUGL GL, SADDR DR WHERE SE.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SE.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SE.RFQ_NUMBER = LN.RFQ_NUMBER AND SE.RFQ_COUNT = LN.RFQ_COUNT AND SE.COMPANY_CODE = LN.COMPANY_CODE AND SE.COMPANY_CODE = GL.COMPANY_CODE AND SE.SELLER_CODE = GL.SELLER_CODE --AND LN.MATERIAL_NUMBER IN ($INS{MATERIAL_NUMBERS}) AND NVL(GL.DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(GL.PURCHASE_BLOCK_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND GL.SELLER_COND IN ('P','R') AND ( UPPER(GL.SELLER_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(GL.SELLER_NAME_LOC) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(GL.IRS_NO) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' AND 1=1 ) GROUP BY GL.HOUSE_CODE , GL.COMPANY_CODE , GL.SELLER_CODE , GL.SELLER_NAME_LOC , GL.IRS_NO
UNION ALL /*역경매*/ SELECT RAGL.HOUSE_CODE , RAGL.COMPANY_CODE , RABD.SELLER_CODE , SUGL.SELLER_NAME_LOC , SUGL.IRS_NO FROM SSUGL SUGL , SRAGL RAGL , SRABD RABD ,SRALN RALN WHERE RAGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND RAGL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND NVL(SUGL.DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(SUGL.PURCHASE_BLOCK_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND RALN.SETTLE_FLAG = 'Y' AND SUGL.HOUSE_CODE = RAGL.HOUSE_CODE AND RABD.SELLER_CODE = SUGL.SELLER_CODE AND RALN.COMPANY_CODE = SUGL.COMPANY_CODE AND RALN.SETTLE_FLAG = RABD.SETTLE_FLAG AND ( UPPER(GL.SELLER_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(GL.SELLER_NAME_LOC) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(GL.IRS_NO) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' AND 1=1 ) AND SUGL.SELLER_COND IN ('P','R')
/*SBDGL,SBDLN,SBDAP,SBDPI,SBDSE*/ UNION ALL /*입찰*/
SELECT BDAP.HOUSE_CODE , SUGL.COMPANY_CODE , SUGL.SELLER_CODE , SUGL.SELLER_NAME_LOC , SUGL.IRS_NO FROM SSUGL SUGL , SBDAP BDAP WHERE SUGL.HOUSE_CODE ='000' AND SUGL.COMPANY_CODE = '1000' AND BDAP.BID_CANCEL = 'N' AND BDAP.FINAL_FLAG = 'Y' AND NVL(SUGL.DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(SUGL.PURCHASE_BLOCK_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND SUGL.SELLER_COND IN ('P','R') AND BDAP.HOUSE_CODE = SUGL.HOUSE_CODE
) T WHERE T.HOUSE_CODE <> '999' GROUP BY T.HOUSE_CODE , T.COMPANY_CODE , T.SELLER_CODE , T.SELLER_NAME_LOC , T.IRS_NO
